items.title: DIT Handbook for International Students
items.reason: Contains an approximately EUR 70/month insurance estimate and older residence-permit photo and office instructions. Also mixes exchange and degree-student procedures.

items.title: DIT Application Procedure for International Students
items.reason: The funding figure is explicitly labelled as of 2023.

items.title: DIT old health-insurance leaflet
items.reason: Describes paper-certificate submission. Current DIT guidance requires electronic confirmation.

items.title: DIT international prospectus 2026
items.decision: Index link retained for optional background reading
items.reason: Large programme catalogue with generic accommodation estimates. More specific arrival and housing sources are supplied.

items.title: DIT general FAQ and practical information - age-based insurance statements
items.decision: Whole page excluded; D28 contains only the relevant general electronic-confirmation and EHIC passages
items.reason: Broad statements about insurance after age 30 need individual insurer confirmation. Avoid presenting private insurance as compulsory solely because of age.

items.title: DIT academic calendar - summer semester 2027
items.decision: Calendar omitted from this arrival corpus
items.reason: The summer-2027 section includes examination and break entries dated 2026. Confirm dates with DIT before adding an academic-calendar answer.

items.title: DIT accommodation page - residence inventory
items.decision: Conflicting inventory count and Bahnhofstrasse description omitted from D08
items.reason: The university page says three residences and gives a different Bahnhofstrasse apartment count. The provider lists four complexes and supplies individual residence details.

items.title: DAAD general health-insurance cost estimate
items.decision: Cost estimate omitted from selected excerpt D24
items.reason: A broad monthly estimate is insufficient for a current individual premium. Confirm the actual contribution with the chosen insurer.
